title: Gemini mimed love. Taurus: “plumber?”
caption:
Gemini mimes a heart in the air, an invisible box and a rope. Taurus guesses peach, window cleaner and plumber, and offers one bite of croissant.
Nobody can read your mind. Saying it plainly is braver, and much clearer.
Send this to the friend who only drops hints.
